onTheRecord.finding: United for Respect's analysis of FEC and state filings (Jan 1, 2023 - Sept 2024) lists Jim C. Walton as the top Walmart/Walton political donor at $14.7 million, including $10 million to Americans for Prosperity and over $2 million to pro-charter-school PACs (Legacy 44 PAC, Charter Public Schools PAC, Charter Schools Now).

Town Branch Foundation paid its Secretary, Buddy D. Philpot, $677,212 compensation plus $174,627 other in FY2024 ($589,326 + $151,964 in FY2023; $605,231 + $156,066 in FY2022); Jim and Lynne Walton take $0.
